Subject: Geo premium recommendation: Senior ML Eng (Singapore remote)

Mina —

Quick summary: recruiting surfaced a strong Senior ML Eng (Sofia Tan, based in Singapore) who is currently in-market and evaluating two offers. Market comp for comparable roles in SG shows a +8% cost-of-living / location premium compared to our US West base bands for senior ICs. The candidate expects total OTE that would put her slightly above band for the role if we only use base-aligned comp.

Ask: recommend approval for a one-time geo premium exception (base +7%, with normal equity and benefits) and include a 6-month retention sign-on (prorated RSU vesting) to keep total target within our hiring budget. This stays under the HC-1193 headcount cap but requires a compensation exception since it exceeds the published band floor.

Attachments: apac-cola-bench-v2.xlsx (bench data), candidate-SofiaTan-CV.pdf

Notes:
- Hiring manager is Mina Haddad (ML infra).
- Recruiter is TalentBridge (jobs@talentbridge.ai).
- Proposed offer draft attached (proposed-offer-draft.docx) — needs legal/HR review for local employment language.

I can summarize quickly for leadership if you want a 10-min readout.

Thanks,
Marissa

Thanks Marissa — this looks well sourced. A few quick questions before I escalate:

1) Is the +7% on base only or on target total comp (i.e., does it affect target bonus calculations)?
2) Can we structure the sign-on as time-limited (12-month clawback) rather than accelerated equity to simplify accounting?
3) Confirm we have HC-1193 budget to cover the delta this fiscal quarter. If not, I can push for reallocation from feature infra hiring budget.

If you and Laura are comfortable with the benchmarking, I can request an exception from Vivek for approval to exceed the published band by up to 10% for APAC hires that meet retention criteria. Please advise and I will schedule a quick sync w/ Vivek.

— Mina

Mina —

Answers inline: 1) +7% is recommended on base salary only; bonus target remains unchanged and prorated in local currency. 2) Agree on a 12-month clawback for the sign-on; avoids accounting complications. 3) HC-1193 currently shows available headcount to cover salary delta through Q2 — Laura can confirm the spend bucket.

If Laura signs off on budget labeling, happy to proceed to Vivek for a fast-track exec exception. I attached the bench data and a short note that summarizes comp comps vs local market.

Marissa
